extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Web Store.

extDescription.message: Stick post-it notes onto any web page and find them waiting for you when you come back.

popupEnable.description: Label next to the on/off switch in the popup.

popupAdd.message: + Add a note to this page
popupAdd.description: Popup button that creates a note.

popupClear.message: Delete every note on this page
popupClear.description: Popup button that clears the current page.

popupHint.message: You can also right-click anywhere on a page and choose "Add a sticky note here".
popupHint.description: Hint text at the bottom of the popup.

statusCount.description: Popup status line showing how many notes the page has.

statusDisabled.description: Shown when the extension is switched off.

statusUnsupported.message: Notes cannot be used on this page.
statusUnsupported.description: Shown for pages where content scripts never run.

statusReload.message: Reload the page to start using notes here.
statusReload.description: Shown when the content script has not been injected yet.

statusRetry.message: Reload the page and try again.
statusRetry.description: Shown when an action could not reach the page.

noteDelete.description: Tooltip for the note's close button.

errorSaveFailed.message: Could not save the note. Storage may be full.
errorSaveFailed.description: Toast shown when writing to chrome.storage fails.
